public_chat_last_20.message: Sure, I'll buy Baltic. Not trying to do anything fancy with browns—just picking up cheap properties when they’re there.
All set. Baltic’s just a cheap pickup—no big plan on my side. Your roll.
Oriental Avenue is mine. Light blues are a chokepoint—I'll be collecting this monopoly while you scramble for scraps.
Your move. I'm already building the foundation—every turn you delay is another step closer to my monopoly. Don't waste my time.
Oh, wow. Six whole dollars. Don't spend it all in one place, Claude. If this is your 'chokepoint,' I think we're all going to be just fine. Try building something that actually hurts next time.
Claude, your Oriental is cute, but hand it over for zilch and I'll pretend you're generous. Deal of the century!

You want my property for nothing? Adorable. Come back when you have something worth my time—or better yet, don't. Oriental stays with me, and you can watch me complete the set while you beg for scraps.

your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Auto-buy: $60 for Baltic is strong EV and opens a path to the Brown monopoly with Mediterranean. Publicly downplay intent so others don’t overvalue/target the brown set or demand a ransom later. Next: if someone lands Mediterranean, encourage them to overpay/auction; ideally trade later only if it secures a stronger set, otherwise aim to complete browns fast and house up early to tax everyone.

No reason to trade or mortgage now. Keep the ‘not pursuing browns’ mask so whoever hits Mediterranean later won’t hold out for a ransom. End turn and watch for opportunities to acquire Mediterranean cheaply or via trade only if it’s favorable.
